page_subtitle: What you spend to run the store, month by month: ads, packaging, calls, rent…
no_access: You need the finance permission to see the store's costs.
load_error: Your costs could not be loaded.

totals.left_out_one: {count} cost is left out: see above
totals.left_out_other: {count} costs are left out: see above

missing.USD: Your costs in dollars are left out from {date}. Set what 1 $ costs you to count them.
missing.EUR: Your costs in euros are left out from {date}. Set what 1 € costs you to count them.

rates.title: What a dollar and a euro cost you
rates.help: Costs in dollars or euros are counted in dinars at your own rate: what you really pay, not the bank's rate. A new rate counts from its day; earlier days keep theirs.
rates.not_set: Not set: costs in this currency are left out

empty.title: No costs yet
empty.body: Add what you spend on ads, packaging, calls and rent. Start from one of these:
empty.body_read: No cost has been added yet.
empty.month_body: None of your costs counts in {month}.

charge_help.per_confirmed: Counted on the day an order is confirmed for the first time.
charge_help.per_shipped: Counted on the day the parcel is handed to a carrier or your driver.
charge_help.per_delivered: Counted on the day the customer receives the order.
charge_help.per_returned: Counted on the day the parcel comes back to you.

category_help.salaries: Your confirmation team's pay is already counted in Team → Payroll. Add here only people outside it, like a packer or a driver on a salary.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.name_placeholder: Facebook ads for the summer dress
sheet.preview_dzd: About {amount} a month at your rate today.
sheet.no_rate: No rate is set for this currency yet: this cost is left out until you set one.
sheet.change_from_hint: Days before keep what they cost.
sheet.stop_body: It counts until today. The months before keep it.
sheet.delete_body: Only for a mistake: it disappears from every month. To end a cost that really ran, stop it instead.
sheet.not_here: Not here: what your products cost you, delivery fees and your confirmation team's pay. They are already recorded from your products, your parcels and Team → Payroll.

rate_sheet.amount_hint: What you really pay for one, not the bank's rate.
rate_sheet.from_hint: Earlier days keep the rate they had.
rate_sheet.remove_body: The days that used it take the rate before it, or are left out if there is none.

errors.name: Give it a name.
errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
errors.rate: Enter what one costs you in dinars, above zero.
errors.stops_before: It stops on or after the day it starts.
errors.has_history: This cost had other amounts before, so it can't become a one-time cost, or stop being one. Add a new cost instead.
errors.dates: These days don't fit: a cost stops on or after the day it starts, and a change applies from today at the latest, while the cost runs.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.changed: Someone changed this cost meanwhile, so nothing was saved. The list is up to date: open the cost again.
